data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Dunaa means 'continuity' or 'perseverance'. It is derived from the root word 'dun' which means 'to sustain' or 'to last'. This name signifies the strength and endurance that one needs to overcome challenges and obstacles in life. The name Dunaa carries the meaning “Perseverance, Continuity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dunaa usually hope their child will grow to embody perseverance, continuity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
